controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.intent: Management defines, approves, publishes and periodically reviews an information security policy and topic-specific policies, and staff acknowledge them.

evidence_requirements.example: Approved Information Security Policy with version history
Policy acknowledgement records for all in-scope staff

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.intent: Security roles and responsibilities are defined, allocated and communicated, including ISMS ownership and asset/risk owners.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.intent: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility are separated so no single person can misuse or alter assets undetected.

evidence_requirements.example: Segregation of duties matrix for critical processes
Role/permission export showing separated approver and executor roles

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.intent: Management requires all personnel to apply security in line with policies and actively supports the ISMS.

evidence_requirements.example: Leadership meeting minutes showing ISMS support

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.intent: The organization maintains contact with relevant authorities (regulators, law enforcement, CERT) and knows when and how to reach them.

evidence_requirements.example: Authority contacts register with owner and last-verified date

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.intent: Membership of security forums and professional associations is maintained to stay informed of threats and good practice.

evidence_requirements.example: Membership confirmation or recent bulletins received

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.intent: Information about threats is collected, analysed and used to produce actionable intelligence that feeds risk and defensive decisions.

evidence_requirements.example: Recent threat intelligence reports / advisories with actions taken

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.intent: Security requirements and risk are integrated into project management for all projects regardless of type.

evidence_requirements.example: Completed security checklist / risk assessment for a sample project

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.intent: An inventory of information and associated assets, with owners, is developed and kept accurate and current.

evidence_requirements.example: Asset inventory with owner, classification, location

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.intent: Rules for acceptable use and handling of information and assets are identified, documented and implemented.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.intent: Personnel and external parties return organizational assets on change or termination of employment or agreement.

evidence_requirements.example: Offboarding procedure with asset return step
Signed asset return forms for recent leavers

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.intent: Information is classified according to security needs based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and stakeholder requirements.

evidence_requirements.example: Asset inventory showing classification per asset

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.intent: Procedures for labelling information are developed and applied in line with the classification scheme.

evidence_requirements.example: Example of labelled document / sensitivity label configuration

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.intent: Rules, procedures or agreements are in place for all types of information transfer, internal and external.

evidence_requirements.example: Secure transfer tool configuration (TLS / encrypted email)

controls.title: Access control
controls.intent: Rules for physical and logical access are established based on business and security requirements (least privilege, need-to-know).

controls.title: Identity management
controls.intent: The full lifecycle of identities (creation, change, removal) is managed; shared identities are restricted.

evidence_requirements.example: Directory export showing unique IDs, no orphan accounts

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.intent: Allocation and management of authentication information (passwords, keys, tokens) is controlled, including user guidance.

evidence_requirements.example: Password policy configuration in identity provider

controls.title: Access rights
controls.intent: Access rights are provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed according to the access control policy.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.intent: Processes manage security risks associated with the use of suppliers' products and services.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.intent: Relevant security requirements are agreed with each supplier based on the type of relationship.

evidence_requirements.example: Supplier contract / DPA with security clauses

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.intent: Processes manage security risks in the ICT products and services supply chain.

evidence_requirements.example: Software/hardware vendor assessments, SBOM where relevant

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.intent: Supplier security practices and service delivery are regularly monitored, reviewed and changes managed.

evidence_requirements.example: Annual supplier review / SOC report review

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.intent: Processes for acquiring, using, managing and exiting cloud services are established in line with security requirements.

evidence_requirements.example: Cloud security policy incl. exit strategy
Cloud service register with shared-responsibility notes

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.intent: Incident management processes, roles and responsibilities are defined, established and communicated.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.intent: Security events are assessed and a decision is made whether to categorize them as incidents.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.intent: Incidents are responded to in accordance with documented procedures.

evidence_requirements.example: Incident tickets with timeline and closure

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.intent: Knowledge gained from incidents strengthens and improves security controls.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.intent: Procedures exist for identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to security events.

evidence_requirements.example: Forensic evidence handling / chain of custody procedure

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.intent: Security is maintained at an appropriate level during disruption.

evidence_requirements.example: Business continuity plan with security considerations

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.intent: ICT readiness is planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on continuity objectives (RTO/RPO).

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.intent: Applicable legal, regulatory and contractual requirements, and the approach to meet them, are identified, documented and kept current.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.intent: Procedures protect intellectual property rights, including licensed software compliance.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.intent: Records are protected from loss, destruction, falsification and unauthorized access or release.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.intent: Requirements for privacy and protection of personally identifiable information are identified and met.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.intent: The approach to managing information security is independently reviewed at planned intervals or on significant change.

evidence_requirements.example: External assessment or penetration test report

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.intent: Compliance with the security policy, topic-specific policies and standards is regularly reviewed.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.intent: Operating procedures for information processing facilities are documented and made available to those who need them.

evidence_requirements.example: Operating procedures / runbooks with owners and review dates

controls.title: Screening
controls.intent: Background verification of candidates is carried out before joining and on an ongoing basis, proportional to risk and law.

evidence_requirements.example: Screening completion records for recent hires

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.intent: Employment contracts state personnel and organizational responsibilities for information security.

evidence_requirements.example: Employment contract template with security clauses

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.intent: Personnel receive appropriate awareness, education and training, and regular updates relevant to their role.

evidence_requirements.example: Training completion report covering all staff

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.intent: A formal and communicated disciplinary process exists for personnel who violate the security policy.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.intent: Security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change are defined, communicated and enforced.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.intent: NDAs reflecting the organization's needs are identified, documented, reviewed and signed by personnel and relevant parties.

evidence_requirements.example: Signed NDAs for staff and contractors

controls.title: Remote working
controls.intent: Security measures protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization's premises.

evidence_requirements.example: VPN / ZTNA and device compliance configuration

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.intent: Personnel have a mechanism to report observed or suspected security events promptly.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.intent: Security perimeters protect areas containing information and associated assets.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.intent: Secure areas are protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.

evidence_requirements.example: Badge access system user list / logs

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.intent: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities is designed and implemented.

evidence_requirements.example: Locked server room / restricted area photos

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.intent: Premises are continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.

evidence_requirements.example: CCTV system status with retention setting

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.intent: Protection against physical and environmental threats (fire, flood, natural disasters) is designed and implemented.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.intent: Security measures for working in secure areas are designed and implemented.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.intent: Clear desk rules for papers and removable media and clear screen rules for facilities are defined and enforced.

evidence_requirements.example: Clear desk and clear screen policy

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.intent: Equipment is sited securely and protected.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.intent: Off-site assets are protected.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.intent: Storage media are managed through their lifecycle of acquisition, use, transport and disposal.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.intent: Facilities are protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

evidence_requirements.example: UPS / generator maintenance and test records

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.intent: Power, data and supporting cables are protected from interception, interference or damage.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.intent: Equipment is maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.intent: Equipment containing storage media is verified so sensitive data and licensed software are removed or securely overwritten before disposal or re-use.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.intent: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices is protected.

evidence_requirements.example: MDM compliance report (encryption, OS version, screen lock)

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.intent: Allocation and use of privileged access rights is restricted and managed.

evidence_requirements.example: List of privileged accounts with justification

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.intent: Access to information and assets is restricted in accordance with the access control policy.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.intent: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries is appropriately managed.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.intent: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented based on access restrictions and the access control policy.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.intent: Use of resources is monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.intent: Protection against malware is implemented and supported by user awareness.

evidence_requirements.example: AV policy with signature update status

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.intent: Information about technical vulnerabilities is obtained, exposure evaluated and appropriate measures taken.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.intent: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks are established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.intent: Information stored in systems, devices or other media is deleted when no longer required.

evidence_requirements.example: Data deletion procedure aligned to retention schedule

controls.title: Data masking
controls.intent: Data masking is used in accordance with access control and business requirements, considering applicable legislation.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.intent: Data leakage prevention measures are applied to systems, networks and devices that process sensitive information.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.intent: Backup copies of information, software and systems are maintained and regularly tested.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.intent: Information processing facilities are implemented with sufficient redundancy to meet availability requirements.

controls.title: Logging
controls.intent: Logs recording activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events are produced, stored, protected and analysed.

evidence_requirements.example: SIEM log sources and retention settings

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.intent: Networks, systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.intent: Clocks of information processing systems are synchronized to approved time sources.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.intent: Use of utility programs capable of overriding system and application controls is restricted and tightly controlled.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.intent: Procedures and measures securely manage software installation on operational systems.

evidence_requirements.example: Restriction of local admin / software deployment tool

controls.title: Networks security
controls.intent: Networks and network devices are secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.intent: Security mechanisms, service levels and requirements of network services are identified, implemented and monitored.

evidence_requirements.example: ISP / network service SLA with security terms

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.intent: Groups of information services, users and systems are segregated in the organization's networks.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.intent: Access to external websites is managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.intent: Rules for effective use of cryptography, including key management, are defined and implemented.

evidence_requirements.example: TLS configuration / encryption at rest settings

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.intent: Rules for secure development of software and systems are established and applied.

evidence_requirements.example: Evidence of security activities in a recent release

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.intent: Security requirements are identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

evidence_requirements.example: Security requirements in specifications / user stories

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.intent: Principles for engineering secure systems are established, documented, maintained and applied.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.intent: Secure coding principles are applied to software development.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.intent: Security testing processes are defined and implemented in the development lifecycle.

evidence_requirements.example: Security test results for a release

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.intent: The organization directs, monitors and reviews activities related to outsourced system development.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.intent: Development, testing and production environments are separated and secured.

controls.title: Change management
controls.intent: Changes to information processing facilities and systems are subject to change management procedures.

evidence_requirements.example: Sample of approved change tickets with testing and rollback

controls.title: Test information
controls.intent: Test information is appropriately selected, protected and managed.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.intent: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving operational systems are planned and agreed between tester and management.

evidence_requirements.example: Audit/test plan agreed with system owner
Rules of engagement for penetration test
